evidence_excerpts: F_XEB = 2^n <P(x_i)>_i - 1, where n is the number of qubits, P(x_i) is the probability of bitstring x_i computed for the ideal quantum circuit, and the average is over the observed bitstrings.
text: Linear cross-entropy benchmarking provides a fidelity measure by comparing experimentally observed bitstrings with ideal probabilities computed by classical simulation.
